english.note: Use 表格 for a data table arranged as rows and columns.

exampleSentences.english: This table lists this month's sales figures.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個表格列出今個月嘅銷售數字。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 biu2 gaak3 lit6 ceot1 gam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 siu1 sau6 sou3 zi6

english.note: Use 表格 when the chart is a grid of rows and columns containing data.

exampleSentences.english: This chart lists the income from every vehicle this month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢張表格列晒今個月每部車嘅收入。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 biu2 gaak3 lit6 saai3 gam1 go3 jyut6 mui5 bou6 ce1 ge3 sau1 jap6
